facts.text: The 16th-century Casa Principal was once home to an archbishop, and the 17th-century Casa Parque was a former fort.
facts.excerpt: From the 16th-century Casa Principal, once home to an archbishop, to the 17th-century Casa Parque, a former fort, every corner tells a story steeped in heritage.

facts.text: The architecture is adorned with ancient masonry, Aztec motifs and baroque details.
facts.excerpt: Our architecture is adorned with ancient masonry, intricate Aztec motifs and baroque details.

facts.text: The hotel is in central San Miguel de Allende, a UNESCO World Heritage site.
facts.excerpt: Situated in central San Miguel de Allende, a UNESCO World Heritage site

facts.text: Tunki Rooftop, run with Handshake, serves Peruvian-inflected tapas.
facts.excerpt: Peruvian-inflected tapas at Tunki Rooftop by Handshake

facts.text: Sazon Cooking School offers expert-led classes in regional Mexican specialties.
facts.excerpt: Learn the secrets of the Mexican kitchen and master regional specialties in our expert-led cooking school.

facts.text: Laja Spa offers therapies influenced by the lessons of the natural world.
facts.excerpt: Rejuvenate body and mind at Laja Spa, where therapies are influenced by the lessons of the natural world.
